charts.title: TOI-5319 b: orbits around TOI-5319
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5319's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5319 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Peláez-Torres et al. 2024 (2024A&A...690A..62P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname PEL_AMP_AACUTE_EZ_TORRES_ET_AL__2024): P 4.07853 d

charts.title: TOI-5319 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-5319 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (58, 70, 71) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 246965431, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 6-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 6-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
